title: How the first three-game mystery box works
subtitle: A free chess challenge with one in-app reward and published odds.
excerpt: Join the free AI challenge, finish three qualifying games, and open one mystery box. See the exact in-app reward odds.
metaDescription: Learn how to unlock the free Web3Chess mystery box after three qualifying AI games, including the rules and reward odds.
takeaways: Join before playing; only free AI games started afterward count.
Finish three games with at least 10 moves per side each.
Open one box per account for 250 XP, a 24-hour XP boost, or a gold profile border.
Rewards are in-app items without cash value. No deposit or purchase is needed.

content.text: A useful chess challenge should make the next move clear. Web3Chess gives new players a simple path: join the first-three challenge, play free games against the AI, then open one mystery box.

items: Join the challenge inside the Mini App before you start a game.
Finish three free AI games, each with at least 20 half-moves (10 moves per side). Wins, losses and draws count.
Return to the challenge card and open your box. Games started before joining, paid games and abandoned games do not count.

content.text: The box awards one in-app reward: 250 XP (60%), a 1.5× XP boost for 24 hours (30%), or a gold profile border (10%). If you already own the border and draw it again, you receive 250 XP instead. The app shows these odds before you join.
This challenge is free, once per account, and has no deadline. The rewards have no cash value and are not GRAM, TON, or Telegram gifts.
Make the next game worth sharing

After practicing, share an actual game or a chess position with a friend. A useful challenge travels farther when the recipient can play or solve it immediately; a prize claim should never be the only reason to invite someone.
